upstream.source_data: Stage 03 features + Stage 06 findings on linear boundary limitations.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: Ad click behavior contains step-function interactions (e.g. specific banner_pos on specific site_category) that linear hyperplanes miss.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Replaces linear hyperplanes w^T x with orthogonal recursive partitioning of the feature space. At each node t, finds split s maximizing Gini impurity reduction.
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(p \cdot N \log N) \text{ per level; Depth pruned at } d=5

downstream.hand_off_contract: Delivers ROC-AUC = 0.6681, Accuracy = 63.88% at depth 5, highlighting C18_enc (54.0% Gini contribution) as the top non-linear splitting feature.
